viewerResultDelivery.result: Selected detachable same-origin Viewer clients of one Runtime Controller, full ViewerStateSnapshot on attach/re-attach, notification-as-hint semantics, runtimeInstanceId/stateRevision synchronization, bounded in-memory latest-success preview and optimistic query activation across multiple Viewer clients.
viewerResultDelivery.previewPersistence: Execution metadata persists; arbitrary result preview payload does not. After runtime restart Viewer reports preview unavailable until a new successful execution.
viewerResultDelivery.multiViewer: Multiple Viewer clients share one runtime/SQL authority; stale query editors are rejected through expectedActiveQueryVersionId rather than silently overwriting newer SQL.

next.action: Planning Phase L: design the Browser SQL testing and verification strategy.
steps: Map each Browser SQL public contract to the cheapest valid test layer.
Define pure Node tests for deterministic IDs/state/scheduler/classification/recovery logic.
Define Playwright Chromium coverage for Worker/Wasm/OPFS/runtime/Viewer integration and reopen behavior.
Define live authenticated-Leumi verification gates that mocks cannot prove.
Define CI split/cadence so Browser CI does not run unnecessarily on every small change.
Define test fixtures for complete/partial cycles, query failures, persistence ambiguity, CSP/capability failures and multi-Viewer behavior.
